title: 재생
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop R&B ballad. Clean electric guitar plays arpeggiated chords with light chorus and reverb. A smooth male tenor vocal performs melodic lines with occasional breathy delivery and subtle vibrato. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the guitar and the vocal. Tempo is 72 BPM in the key of G Major. The guitar maintains a steady eighth-note fingerstyle pattern throughout.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean arpeggiated electric guitar]

[Verse 1]

가슴이 뛰어
